description: Webhook-URL shape cases pinned by apps/web/lib/ssrf/webhook-url.ts (isPublicHttpsWebhookUrl), the MCP schema in apps/mcp/src/schedule-shapes.ts, and the engine schema validator (apps/engine/app/models/schema.py via apps/engine/app/utils/ssrf.py). accepted must validate and rejected must not. The check is https-only and shape-only: no DNS. A host name is accepted without resolution (resolution and pinning happen later, on the delivery path); only localhost names and non-public literal IP addresses are rejected here. Multicast literals are deliberately left out: Python still reports them global (blockedBeyondPython in public-ip-cases.json), so the engine accepts them while the web and MCP block them; that divergence is asserted in the web and MCP tests only. Any drift between the three implementations on the rows above fails the matching sync test.
